title: Authorized Tenant runtime dependency injection, exact readback, restart reconciliation, and rollback

phases.objective: Inject only a canonical consumed authorized-mount bundle into an immutable Tenant route dependency snapshot, keep the route fail-closed until exact readback verifies runtime identity, and preserve all non-provider and non-production boundaries.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A canonical authorized mount bundle from the durable one-shot executor
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The immutable route dependency snapshot exposes the exact synthetic-only tenantStorageRuntime only after receipt-bound readback verifies object identity; before readback the Tenant route returns HTTP 503.
steps: Reject policy overrides, unbranded bundles, unsafe fields, digest drift, runtime SHA drift, and authorization-generation drift.
Create one immutable dependency snapshot with a non-enumerable, non-configurable, non-writable tenantStorageRuntime property.
Record an injection receipt without modifying the live server, route registry, worker, provider, database, or deployment surface.
Keep resolveRouteDependencies fail-closed until the exact injection receipt and mount bundle digests are read back.
Verify the dependency descriptor, frozen snapshot, exact runtime object identity, synthetic-only flag, provider-dispatch denial, and production denial.
Resolve the verified dependency snapshot and prove the existing Tenant route moves from runtime-unavailable HTTP 503 to its bounded request validator without executing provider work.
assertions: A non-canonical copied bundle is rejected.
Only one active injection slot is allowed.
Before exact readback, no tenantStorageRuntime dependency is returned and the route responds with storage_tenant_runtime_unavailable.
After exact readback, the resolved property value is the same runtime object held by the canonical mount bundle.
The route dependency snapshot is frozen and the runtime descriptor is non-enumerable, non-configurable, and non-writable.
No live server or live route registration mutation occurs.
No provider dispatch, Hostinger access, SSH access, credential access, migration, deployment, main merge, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Persist injection receipt and verified readback through a separately governed durable runtime composition without granting live provider or deployment authority.
Reconstruct the verified dependency snapshot after restart without consuming authorization again, and rollback to the fail-closed HTTP 503 state using the exact active readback digest.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A serialized injection receipt, serialized verified mount readback, and the reconstructed canonical authorized mount bundle
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Restart reconciliation reproduces the identical readback digest without a second authorization consumption, and rollback removes route dependencies so the Tenant route returns HTTP 503 again.
steps: Verify serialized receipt and readback contracts and recompute their SHA-256 digests.
Bind authorization, mount bundle, dependency manifest, runtime SHA, source commit, database fingerprint, schema evidence, and readback cycle.
Recreate the immutable route dependency descriptor from the canonical mount bundle.
Require the reconstructed readback digest to equal the persisted digest exactly.
Reject rollback unless it references the exact active verified readback.
Remove the active dependency snapshot and restore the default runtime-unavailable HTTP 503 response.
Reject rollback replay and leave automatic retry disabled.
assertions: Restart reconciliation performs no second durable authorization consumption.
The reconstructed mount readback digest is identical to the original digest.
Rollback sets dependency_injected, runtime_mounted, and route_mounted to false.
Rollback restores fail_closed_route_restored=true and HTTP 503 storage_tenant_runtime_unavailable.
Automatic retry, worker mount, provider dispatch, production readiness, and secrets remain false.

phases.objective: Observe one separately authorized non-production route-composition canary using persisted injection and rollback evidence.
This repository-only dependency snapshot grants no deployment, provider, migration, main, or Production authority.
